stem:
Alethia models the length of time, in minutes, by which her train is late on any day by the random variable $X$ with probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{3}{8000}(x - 20)^2 & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 20, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the train is more than 10 minutes late on each of two randomly chosen days.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The median of $X$ is denoted by $m$.

Show that $m$ satisfies the equation $(m - 20)^3 = -4000$, and hence find $m$ correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: State one way in which Alethia’s model may be unrealistic.
